messages.author: c5246646595bff41
messages.subject: Placing histogram on x axis
parts:
Good Morning,

The geom_histogram() places the histogram (and density) on a base line of zero with space between the zero line and the x axis that contains the tick marks. Is there a way to make the histogram "sit" on top of the x axis without the extra margin?

Thanks

David

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Placing histogram on x axis
parts:
Good morning David,

Does one of these options work for you?

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=mpg)) +
geom_histogram() +
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0, 4.5))


ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=mpg)) +
geom_histogram() +
scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0, 0))

Best,
Ista
